text: {"lessons":["My account fell substantially while I made no trades, then recovered somewhat; inactivity avoids trading but does not eliminate market risk.","Repeatedly adding to stocks after declines or selling stocks after large gains can reshape my portfolio without a reliable forecast of what comes next; I should check position sizes and diversification before trading.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should set a deliberate risk level and follow it consistently rather than letting recent losses or gains drive my decisions."]}
